snippet.title: Wish Impossible - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Wish Impossible on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5183520/Wish_Impossible/

Santa burned out and took off for Hawaii.
Now Christmas is in the hands of a crew of tiny gingerbread cookies.

Wish Impossible is a 1–4 player online co-op physics adventure. Sneak into houses, find and grant each wish, move objects much bigger than you, and survive the chaos.

Preferably without destroying the house.

Developed by EDEL Studio.

#WishImpossible #CoopGames #IndieGame
